messages:
morgan: Quick heads up — we're bundling two Frontend IC interviews into a single block on Wed to reduce context switching for the panel. Plan: candidate A 11:00–11:30 PT, 15m buffer, candidate B 11:45–12:15 PT, debrief 12:15–12:35. If you absolutely can't do back-to-back 30m pls say now so we can swap.

anita: Quick Q — are we on the new 1–5 rubric or the older 0–3? Also where's the debrief form link?

morgan: new 1–5 rubric (we rolled it out last month). Debrief form: https://redwood-internal.hq/debriefs/frontend. Use the checkbox for 'blocker' if you think the candidate can't ship the role.

samir: I can cover both, but would prefer to swap the second slot with @lee if possible — timezone note: I'm PST -> GMT+1 in the afternoon, so the second slot is slightly better for me.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: Please submit debriefs within 24h (:hourglass_flowing_sand:). Also ensure candidate consent before recording — see policy: https://redwood-internal.hq/policies/recording.

jordan: For the rubric anchors: can someone give a 1-sentence anchor for "system design" high vs mid? Helps calibrate quickly in the debrief.

morgan: sure. High = proposes a simple, scalable architecture with clear tradeoffs (latency vs cost), identifies bottlenecks and testing strategy. Mid = knows core components but misses concrete tradeoffs or performance numbers. Low = vague architecture or missing major constraints.

lee: @samir happy to swap second slot — I can take candidate B. Samir, confirm and I'll update my calendar.

anita: small ask — can we keep a 10m prep buffer instead of 15? I need that to open candidate repo quickly. If not, 15 is ok.

morgan: let's keep 15 this time to avoid overruns, but i'll add a 10m "prep" event to the individual invites so folks who want less buffer can still prep. Calendar updated and invites resent.

morgan: Thanks all — updated calendar + debrief link. Ping me if you need to opt out or if recording consent is an issue. :thumbsup:
